english.note: Use 跌 as the all-purpose choice for something falling, and for prices or levels going down.
This is the all-purpose choice for falling or dropping suddenly, including prices or values.
Use 跌 when a price, rate, level, or physical object goes down or falls.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for profits, prices, or other figures moving downward.

examples.english: I saw the temperature drop by ten degrees today.
examples.traditional: 我今日見到氣溫跌咗十度。
